theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners lead the momentum ranks with strong breadth (0.933) and are eligible under the validated absolute-trend gate, so this is the one theme where the trend-discipline leg (the only forward edge) currently aligns with leadership. Momentum rank itself is not a return forecast, but the gate helps avoid shake-outs and the theme is not crowded (crowding_z 0.54). Lean is a directional preference, not a return claim.
theses.dissent: Momentum rank has rank-IC ~0 on clean sectors, so leadership carries no proven forward edge; gold could mean-revert if the macro risk-off bid fades.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO gives back its rank-1 leadership and lags the S&P/TSX benchmark by 3% before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the immediate challenger (score 1.627, margin to leader only 0.173) with high breadth (0.917) and eligible under the trend gate. It is a precious-metals proxy alongside Gold, and the rotation read shows a leader/challenger pair within the same category — a cohesive leadership cluster rather than a handoff. Lean on the cluster, not a rotation call.
theses.dissent: No validated forward edge from the momentum rank; a silver-specific idiosyncratic move could decouple it from gold and underperform the benchmark.

falsifier.text: The silver/royalty proxy tracks gold's drawdown but fails to recover relative to XGD.TO in the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper ranks third, is eligible under the trend gate, and has positive score (1.308) with breadth 0.667. However its hurst_tag is mean-revert, so this is a weaker trend candidate than gold or silver. Lean is tentative and driven only by the gate eligibility, not by any momentum edge.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting dynamics plus already-elevated crowding_z (0.91) suggest the move could reverse; copper is tightly linked to the AI/tech macro headline which is itself unscheduled noise.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO reverses its eligible-trend status and closes below its 20-day average before the check-by date.
